svg.aria-label: The two subsea imaging primitives, their shared enablers and deployment reality
svg.title: Two subsea primitives — 2026-Jul-08 CV update
svg.desc: A two-column comparison of the two subsea imaging primitives. The left column, optical (light), shows the signal (RGB camera, stereo, ROV video through water), what breaks it (wavelength-dependent attenuation, backscatter haze, blue-green colour cast, turbidity, only a few metres of range) and the consequence (appearance survives but is degraded; enhancement helps per image, not as blanket preprocessing). The right column, acoustic (sound), shows the signal (sound pulses via forward-looking, side-scan, synthetic-aperture and multibeam sonar), what breaks it (speckle, no colour, low resolution, few pixels on target, viewpoint dependence, the acoustic shadow carries the class cue) and the consequence (geometry not appearance; range-independent detail only with synthetic-aperture sonar; imagery scarce and expensive). A shared band lists common enablers: physics-based simulation and diffusion synthesis, in-domain self-supervision and JEPA, SAM and CLIP foundation models, open vocabulary. A bottom band lists the deployment reality: AUV/ROV real-time inference on embedded and neuromorphic edge, extreme label scarcity, domain shift across water type, site and sensor.
svg.text: TWO SUBSEA SIGNALS — ONE STACK OF PROBLEMS

g.text: OPTICAL · light
RGB / stereo camera · ROV & AUV video
Signal — photons travelling through water
reflected light reaches a lens; colour + texture
are present, so it looks like ordinary vision…
…but the water breaks it
wavelength-dependent attenuation · backscatter haze
blue-green colour cast · turbidity · low contrast
usable range only a few metres
Consequence
appearance survives but degraded; enhancement
helps per-image, not as blanket preprocessing
ACOUSTIC · sound
FLS · side-scan (SSS) · synthetic-aperture (SAS) · multibeam
Signal — sound pulses, echoes timed & imaged
works in zero-visibility, turbid or deep water
at tens–hundreds of metres of range
…but it is nothing like a photo
speckle · no colour · low resolution · few px-on-target
viewpoint-dependent; the acoustic shadow — not the
highlight — carries the class cue
Consequence
classify by geometry not appearance; range-independent
detail only with SAS; imagery scarce & expensive
SHARED ENABLERS — routing around scarce labels
physics-based simulation + diffusion / GAN synthesis · in-domain SSL & JEPA
SAM / SAM2 / SAM3 & CLIP foundation models · open-vocabulary detection
DEPLOYMENT REALITY — the operating point that matters
AUV / ROV real-time inference on embedded & neuromorphic edge
extreme label scarcity · domain shift across water type, site & sensor
